facts.raw_span: stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, involving nasolabial folds
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Creatine kinase: 1088 U/L
Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody: negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers
Grade 4/5 strength on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally
Limited flexion of both hips

support_spans: stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:640 with speckled pattern
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
concepts.why: The patient's melanoma and dermatomyositis-like symptoms may be related, as melanoma is a known cause of paraneoplastic dermatomyositis.

support_spans: Creatine kinase: 1088 U/L
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers
concepts.why: The patient's muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase levels, and muscle biopsy results are consistent with polymyositis, although the absence of inflammatory myositis on biopsy is unusual.

support_spans: Creatine kinase: 1088 U/L
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
contradict_spans: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
concepts.why: The patient's muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase levels developed after starting ipilimumab treatment, suggesting a possible drug-induced myositis.
The negative Jo-1 antibody result does not rule out anti-synthetase syndrome, which can present with similar symptoms and laboratory findings, including elevated creatine kinase and aldolase levels.

rationales.F01: Melanoma is associated with dermatomyositis, particularly in the context of paraneoplastic syndromes.
rationales.F03: Photodistributed eruption is a characteristic skin finding in dermatomyositis.
rationales.F06: Elevated creatine kinase levels are indicative of muscle damage, which is a hallmark of myositis.
rationales.F07: The presence of antinuclear antibodies with a speckled pattern is consistent with an autoimmune myositis, such as dermatomyositis or polymyositis.
rationales.F08: The absence of Jo-1 antibodies makes anti-synthetase syndrome less likely.
rationales.F09: MRI findings of muscle hyperintensity are consistent with myositis.
rationales.F10: Muscle biopsy showing atrophy of type II fibers is consistent with myopathic changes seen in dermatomyositis and polymyositis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of specific skin findings such as photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, and erythema and edema of upper eyelids, along with elevated creatine kinase levels, decided it.
